extracted.name: Thyme-Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Fresh Cranberries
extracted.description: This thyme-roasted Brussels sprouts with fresh cranberries recipe turns basic sprouts into a side dish with earthy herbs, cranberries, and maple syrup.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss Brussels sprouts in a bowl with olive oil, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet in an even layer.
Cook in the preheated oven for 10 minutes; stir in cranberries. Continue cooking for 10 minutes more.
Transfer sprouts and cranberries to a serving bowl; drizzle with maple syrup and toss to coat.
